outcome: maternal hemodynamic parameters (systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen saturation)
perioperative adverse reactions (arrhythmias, dizziness, nystagmus, hypotension)
umbilical artery/vein blood gas analysis (pH, PCO2, PO2)
cohort: Pregnant patients receiving epidural anesthesia for emergency cesarean sections between January 2020 and December 2022 were included.
finding: Intravenous esketamine (0.25 mg/kg) during emergency cesarean sections was associated with increased maternal blood pressure and perioperative adverse reactions, but also decreased hypotension incidence and improved neonatal umbilical artery pH, without significant differences in other measured neonatal outcomes.
